title: Three Hours and One Short Gate
subtitle: 交通运输 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通运输（人与社会·交通与旅行）
meta: 主题语境：交通运输（人与社会·交通与旅行）　|　核心词汇：flight　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 flight 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 my uncle ① took a flight that no clerk in the airport would have recorded, and he said the taking was the whole of the morning. The ② flight, meaning the journey itself and not the plane, ran three hours and stayed unrecorded in the book; a flight, he said, is the only thing in an airport that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ flight in that airport had the same short gate beside it, and the ④ flight at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A flight, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; my uncle said the recording is the part that fills three hours.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the flight was the whole of the matter, meaning the escape and not the journey. The ⑥ flight, meaning the escape and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; flight, she said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a journey and an escape. She said the escape is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ flight had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short gate. The ⑧ flight of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in June, was one airport and three hours of recording; flight, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ flight I remember is the one recorded in the plan, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the airport. A ⑩ flight, my mother said in 1981, is the only one that improves by being recorded; every flight, she said, is an escape that has agreed to look like a journey. She said the escape was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 航班；飞行（指机场里每一趟旁边的那一趟）
B. n. 航班（指那一趟本身，与飞机相对）
C. 固定搭配：take a flight 乘一趟航班
D. n. 航班（指留给孩子们的那一趟）
E. n. 航班（抽象总称，指一座机场的航行之事）
F. n. 航班（指计划里写到、被记录过的那一趟）
G. n. 逃跑；逃离（take flight，指一件事里人人都等却无人记录的那样东西）
H. n. 逃跑（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人记录的那样东西）

items.q: took a flight that no clerk in the airport would have recorded
The flight, meaning the journey itself and not the plane
the flight at the far end
the flight was the whole of the matter
the flight had become a line in a plan
The flight of the whole thing
A flight, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: take a flight 意为“乘一趟航班”，1970 年叔叔乘了一趟机场里没有一位职员肯记录的航班。
flight 意为“航班”，指那一趟本身而不是飞机，它经过了三个小时而在簿子上没有被记录。
flight 意为“航班”，指机场里每一趟旁边的那一趟，每一趟旁边都有同一道矮矮的登机口。
flight 意为“航班”，指留给孩子们的那一趟，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
flight 意为“逃跑、逃离”，指一件事里人人都等却无人记录的那样东西，姑姑说这场逃离就是那件事的全部。
flight 意为“逃跑”，指人人都等却无人记录的那样东西而不是那一趟航班，是事情里人人都等、却无人记录的东西。
flight 意为“航班”，指计划里写到、被记录过的那一趟，到 1977 年这一趟成了计划里的一行。
flight 意为“航班”，叔叔六月写道，整件事的航行之事是一座机场和三个小时的记录。
flight 意为“航班”，我记得的是计划里记录过的那一趟，1979 年结束了，至今仍被说成机场里最安静的一趟。
flight 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，一趟航班是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的东西。
